translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yon wok ban bomin kinim leiw kidelsa sung uta ko.

Kale itol mit dim fako yak kin madik kal be Taibidias Sisa ata atin kamok dukum kei kin mo nadanade bakan wakel dau kamok kamok am akfak tem kin mo bidiw iyo ki Bantias Bailet ata Yuddia kamok keidane, Edot akal Galili bakan kin moda nade alam muk anung Filiw ata Itudia so Tadekonaitis so Laiseniyas so Abilin so uyo adikum ata kin moda nade
Anas so Kayafas so itane bokal kayak kei áliwo Got weng uyo madák Sekadaya min Yon ayo anang iwán sed gisa bakan kal tein alayo tad am dim abesu.

Kale Yon aka Got weng uyo kudew wok Yoddan kim luda kal bakan ká bom nadale bakoyam, “kiba ban keimin uyo atin ibik dumam nadiwade wok ban bodokabiw, beta aka kim ban keimin uyo lukuwá kudáyamokaba kala.” Yakansa.
Kale Got godin weng mak lum senin kinim Aiseya ata buk godusa uyo kalesu.

content.text: “Kinim mak anang iwán sed gisa bakan kal gán dá, ‘kiba, Kamokim ami leiw uyo kidela tudon leiw kuw keidaw sidiwo,

wok lúng lúng adikum tawal ati nadiwe adikum amgu so lok falfalin so uyo bilela dau ifi nadiwe leiw falal falalin leiw uyo tatun kuw keidin ade leiw fakadisu fakadásuin leiw mafak uyo luk bala unemin leiw kuw keidin kala.
Adikum mew kinim teinu mánu iyo Got ami Watakayamin ayo atamokabiw.’”

content: Wanang kinim deng mak deng mak iyo tad Yon atamuwo wok ban boyamako kale tadiwo, aka bakoyam nadale, “Mafakim muduw kiba! Kan ata bakoyamano, Got ami aket keng atud uyo fingon dá sakaboduwo, kalbiwe?

Kiba kukuw kidel kuw faku tadiwo, itam kiba ban keimin uyo ibik wakumamiwe kaleyano, aude kiba aket fukan dá bako nadiwade, ‘Ebadakkam be nulum awadiko’ kalin bá. Watawo kaleyo bá, kiba Ebadakkam am kukuw taw uyo fakudongin banim, kayo kiba am muduw bá ka. Got aka ken Ebadakkam man low takudawano, kaloma uyo aka ken tum tum bula kumadela matam Ebadakkam muduw keidomu ka.
Kale kabak mak as wakeladi bakan abuko, kale as mit kuti faskoba. Kale yak as gim kidel mak abumongin dakosu, be wakela dibinoda yak as abokaba.” Kala nade
wanang kinim isik weng atung fakodu bakodaw, “á bo yaknamoduwane?” Akiwe,
Yon asik weng atung fakadu bakoyam, “yak kan kawta gid lim alew faku badaw namti, yak mak bo kawkinum gid lim banim be am kudaw, wáw yak kan kawta wanin so namti, ulutaw kun kuw kanamin ko.
Yak gawman takis kuámin kinim iyo iliso wok ban boyamako, kale tadbiw iyo dákadá bakodawiw. “Kukumin kinim kaba, nuka yaknamokabuwe?” Akiwe,
aka bakoyam, “kiba gawman kisol mak kutiyam kano kal kuw kisol takis kudámino, yakeisa uyo akamam fakadew tow auyámin bá.” Yakeisa.

Beta alo un tabudin isik dákadálaw nadiwade kaliw ko. “A nuka yaknamokabuwe?” Akiwe, aka bakoyam, “wanang kinim iyo sák tatalya bom kasen kei kisol dakiyaman bom nadiwade bisok imadew tam kot kei bom keimin bá, kibi kibilim kisol ki kudu kalfalin beta ken ka.”
Yak bom kei badane wanang kinim iyo Got ami Walusa Kinim leiw fenusiw kayo im aket diking dakung bom nadiwe Yon be Got ami Walusa Kinime? Ak bidiwo,

Yon aka weng kufo adikum bakoyam, “naka sák bisák wok ban kuw boyamokabi ka. Kinim mak nam yán tem tadokaba aka nataw bá, aka kinim abem soim. Kale naka fák am as fakiw dádawomi banim be. Ata Got Sinik Abem so imkukumin mámin so kudew tad kiwa imudokaba ko.
Got aka dukak dakadula tad tad keidune, aka wom so wod so bo takel dáda dákabane, yak dam ki dew tam am dawti nadale wom so wod so be as sun kain bom biyámin as abudokaba ko.” Kalesa.
Yon ayo weng guton seng bakayam bom nadale sung kidel dawkáyamsa.
Kata Yon aka Edot ilim gawman dukum ayo kuek didaw kanadawsa uyo watawo kaleyo masi bá, kukuw mafak seng seng faku bom alam muk anung ami kadel Edoddias uyo takidawse kayo ko.
Kale Edot ayo kukuw mafak faku nadane Yon ayo sok gei dawo kalabus am yal lei dabadála ko.
Wok ban bomin so Yesus ami kinim mit so sung uta ko.
Kale Yon ayo wanang kinim adikum iyo wok ban boyam bom nadano Yesus alaso wok bodawse kale. Kale Yesus ayo suksuka nade abid tikin ibin uyo bisu kaú madik una madik una audane,

Sinik Abem ayo awon samsam ulutaw madák Yesus kiwa dauda ka. Akane, weng mak abid tikino kaw tam kalo bako nadale, “bela nalam Man, nam aket dukum uyo amal kalbu ade ‘naka kam idak teinbi.’ Akbi.” Kalesa ko.
Kinim mit dauda dák dák tadom Yesus dausidiw sung uta ko.

Kale Yesus ayo itol deng mak dutamo alewbino dákan kei nadano Got weng kukuyamin wok uyo mit kei kudew tabesa. Kale im aket bo Yesus be atin Yosew alam man adik dáw kala kalesiw. Yosew be Elai ami man,
Elai be Matat ami man, Matat be Liwai ami man Liwai be Melkai ami man, Melkai be Yenai ami man, Yenai be Yosew ami man, Yosew be Matatayas ami man,
Matatayas be Emas ami man, Emas be Neyam ami man, Neyam be Eslai ami man, Eslai be Nakgai ami man, Nakgai be Mat ami man,
Mat be Matatayas ami man, Matatayas be Semein ami man, Semein be Yosek ami man, Yosek be Yoda ami man Yoda be Yoanan ami man,
Yoanan be Adesa ami man, Adesa be Sedubabel ami man, Sedubabel be Seltiel ami man, Seltiel be Nedai ami man, Nedai be Melkai ami man,
Melkai be Eddai ami man, Eddai be Kosam ami man, Kosam be Elmaddam ami man, Elmaddam be Ed ami man, Ed be Yosuwa ami man,
Yosuwa be Eliesa ami man, Eliesa be Yodim ami man, Yodim be Matat ami man, Matat be Liwai ami man, Liwai be Simiyon ami man,
Simiyon be Yudda ami man, Yudda be Yosew ami man, Yosew be Yonam ami man, Yonam be Elayakkim ami man, Elayakkim be Melia ami man,
Melia be Mena ami man, Mena be Matata ami man, Matata be Netan ami man, Netan be Dewit ami man, Dewit be Yesi ami man,
Yesi be Aubet ami man, Aubet be Boas ami man, Boas be Salmon ami man, Salmon be Nason ami man, Nason be Aminaddaw ami man,
Aminaddaw be Adám ami man, Adám be Esadan ami man, Esadan be Bedes ami man, Bedes be Yudda ami man, Yudda be Yekkow ami man,
Yekkow be Aisak ami man, Aisak be Ebadakkam ami man, Ebadakkam be Teda ami man, Teda be Nekkod ami man, Nekkod be Seduk ami man,
Seduk be Udeyu ami man, Udeyu be Belek ami man, Belek be Ebed ami man, Ebed be Sila ami man, Sila be Keinan ami man,
Keinan be Afaksat ami man, Afaksat be Sem ami man, Sem be Nowa ami man, Nowa be Lamek ami man, Lamek be Metusela ami man,
Metusela be Inak ami man, Inak be Yedet ami man, Yedet be Mayálalel ami man, Mayálalel be Keinan ami man, Keinan be Inos ami man,
Inos be Set ami man, Set be Addam ami man, Addam be Got ami man ko.
